profile.name: Maya
profile.appearance: warm skin tone with dark curly hair

pages.text: Maya took an empty treat bucket and made their way to the open door. Noodle was waiting outside.
pages.guidance: Preserve the full chair silhouette and step-free route; do not substitute a standing pose.

pages.text: Maya and Noodle joined the crowd near the giant pumpkin lantern. Together, they watched the Monster Star glow.
pages.guidance: Keep an accessible clear route and the same chair colors, wheels, casters, and footplate.

pages.text: Maya and Noodle led the parade beneath the glowing stars. The treat bucket rode safely beside Maya.
pages.guidance: Show equal participation; the bucket is attached without hiding the chair or changing seated proportions.

pages.text: Maya followed Noodle along the wide garden path, then paused beside the warm golden clue.
pages.guidance: No stairs or narrow barriers; preserve the same wheelchair and seated child identity.
